item.title: Beyond the Prompt: Infrastructure Costs of Scraping
item.description:
Earlier this year, I co-wrote (with J. Scott Christianson) a paper titled “Beyond the Prompt: The Social Costs of Generative Artificial Intelligence”. In this paper, we explored how generative artificial intelligence affects the digital commons (e.g., the internet), particularly the organizations and communities responsible for making information publicly available.

One of the topics we discussed was scraping and the costs imposed on organizations around the world.

But not all systems are created equal, and neither are the costs of operating them at scale.
